objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with weakness and fatigue.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’ve been feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially toward the end of the day, to the point that it’s hard to do my usual self-care. I’ve also noticed some mild double vision. I’ve been traveling, hiking, and camping recently, and I’ve had several illnesses lately.”

turns.doctor_question:
Morning stiffness can be an important symptom that helps us understand your condition better.

**Do you often feel stiff when you wake up in the morning, especially in your joints or muscles?** Does this stiffness usually improve as you move around and get started with your day?
turns.patient_answer: “Not really—when I wake up I don’t feel much joint or muscle stiffness, and it doesn’t seem to improve with movement. Instead, my weakness and fatigue build later in the day, and that’s when it becomes most difficult to take care of myself.”

turns.doctor_question:

turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not feeling any chest pain or discomfort. It’s mainly the weakness and fatigue that get worse toward the end of the day, along with the mild double vision.”

turns.patient_answer: “Yes—carrying groceries and lifting everyday items has become difficult, and it feels worse as the day goes on.”
